Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the time on Friday. Per our conversation, the team at Novacorp sounded interested in a short, hands-on demo focused on:
- inference latency and cost tradeoffs at 1M/day traffic patterns
- integration patterns (prefix caching, batching) with your event pipeline
- observability: per-route token cost + tracing hooks

Proposed slots next week (PDT):
- Wed 4/14, 10:00–10:45
- Thu 4/15, 14:00–14:45

Attached is a compact demo deck and a one-page checklist for the pilot (attachment: 20270412-llm-demo-deck.pdf). If none of those times works, send me a couple of windows and we’ll adapt.

If it helps, Karthik can cover the infra/quantization notes and Monica can speak to rollout/observability.

Cheers,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Hannah —

Thanks for the options and the deck. Quick update from our side: engineering just cut a scope change — the data platform team pulled two engineers onto an urgent migration sprint next week, which will overlap with the windows you proposed.

Can we move the demo to mid-May? Prefer the week of May 17th. I want to keep this on our roadmap but we have to be realistic about capacity this quarter.

Also, if you have a short 10–15 minute recording of the demo or a TL;DR doc we can circulate internally, that would help keep the wider team informed without pulling folks into a live session.

Appreciate it —

Thanks for being flexible.
